taxonomy.note: Current Kew accepts the nominate subspecies and includes Texas in its native range.

target_zone_range.evidence_basis: Hays project source pool lists the nominate concept; Travis herbarium index has S. lanceolatum var. lanceolatum. Williamson's detailed treatment is var. hesperium, so it is not counted toward the nominate subspecies.
target_zone_range.blocking_issue: Need a third exact target-zone county for the nominate subspecies.
target_zone_range.guardrail: Do not use Williamson var. hesperium as evidence for subsp. lanceolatum without a taxonomic bridge.

morphology.look_here_first: White panicle aster is a tall rhizomatous perennial of moist ground with narrow lanceolate leaves and many small white-rayed heads in a broad panicle; confirm infraspecific characters before assigning the nominate subspecies.
